controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: Published prolate shape fit: 50 × 36 × 36 km. The third axis is assumed equal to the shorter measured axis. Voyager observations constrain size and elongation but do not resolve a useful mapped surface. The standard gray grid marks unavailable mapped imagery; no terrain or albedo pattern is invented.
